spots.name: Wolf - Bordalo II
spots.blurb: You've reached Wolf - Bordalo II, a mural by Bordalo II from 2016. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.blurb: You've reached Mural of O histórico mercado semanal by Milu Correch, a mural by Milu Correch from 2015. It shows O histórico mercado semanal. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
